meta_data.base_class: retrieve the estimated waiting time at a specific <public venue> - these venues usually involve queues or reservations for entry or service.

tool_template.name: get_<class>_waiting_time
tool_template.description: Retrieve the estimated waiting time at a specific <class>.

time_of_day.description: Specific time of day for which <class> waiting time is requested, e.g., 'morning', 'afternoon', 'evening'.

entry_type.description: Type of entry for the <class>, such as 'general admission' or 'membership'.

return_waiting_range.description: If true, returns a waiting time range (e.g., 20-35 minutes) instead of a single average value for the <class>.

wait_time_accuracy.description: Required accuracy level for the estimated waiting time (upper bound), e.g., 'approximate' or 'precise'.
